parameters.jsCode:
// Style guides read from Drive (folder 1zMS_hXAdyBPHFOyP0NE-3sLcqoo4fdAj) via the Google Drive connector on 02.11.26.
// Drive modifiedTime at read: da/fi/no/pl all 24.09.26. Re-read and update this node only when a guide is edited.
const NL = String.fromCharCode(10);
const G = {
da: [
  "Danish Style Guide – Global (DRAFT v2, read 02.11.26). Glossary takes precedence.",
  "Spelling: Retskrivningsordbogen (Dansk Sprognævn). Abbreviations: f.eks., dvs., osv., nr., kl., t, min, sek.",
  "Tone: informal, helpful, engaging yet professional; active voice; clear and readable, avoid long complex or noun-heavy formal sentences; no word-for-word translation, rephrase naturally.",
  "Register: always 'du'; never 'De'.",
  "Inclusiveness: gender-neutral words where possible.",
  "Buttons and CTAs: imperative (Start nu, Få mere at vide). Help-center headlines: infinitive (Opsige dit abonnement). Instructions in body text: imperative (Åbn Indstillinger, og vælg Abonnement).",
  "Syntax: avoid overusing possessive pronouns (Åbn kameraet på telefonen).",
  "Capitalization: sentence case; when citing UI elements capitalize the first letter, no quotation marks (Klik på Gem). TM: Fortrolighedspolitik, Vilkår for brug.",
  "Punctuation: traditional comma; full stop after complete sentences, none in headlines; exclamation marks and superlatives sparingly; straight quotes '…'; hyphen for ranges (1-5); write 'og' instead of '&'.",
  "Numbers: 9,99; 10.000; percent '5 %' (non-breaking space); non-breaking space between number and unit (10 cm, 5 min).",
  "Currency: number + non-breaking space + ISO code (5 USD).",
  "Time/date: kl. 21.00; 12. oktober 2025 or 12.10.2025."
].join(NL),
fi: [
  "Finnish Style Guide – Global (DRAFT v2, read 02.11.26). Glossary takes precedence.",
  "Spelling: current standard Finnish. Abbreviations: esim., ts., jne., nro, klo, h, min, s.",
  "Tone: good standard Finnish, no colloquial language; active voice, straightforward; avoid overusing politeness words like 'please' (ole hyvä).",
  "Register: informal singular (sinä), mostly implicit through verb and possessive suffixes (Antamasi sähköpostiosoite ei kelpaa. Nollaa salasanasi…).",
  "Inclusiveness: avoid gendered nouns (-mies compounds) when a neutral alternative exists.",
  "Headings: noun or verb forms depending on context. Buttons and CTAs: imperative 2nd person singular (Lataa, Kirjaudu sisään, Rekisteröidy).",
  "Capitalization: sentence case, never English title case (Tietosuojakäytäntö, Käyttöehdot).",
  "Lists: full-sentence bullets start with capital and end with full stop; non-sentence bullets start with capital, no full stop; bullets continuing the lead-in start lowercase, last one ends with full stop.",
  "Punctuation: curved quotes ” ” and apostrophe ’; no space before ? ! : ;; hyphen for compounds, en dash for number ranges; exclamation marks sparingly; write 'ja' instead of '&'.",
  "Numbers: thousands separator non-breaking space, decimal comma; percent '5 %' with non-breaking space; non-breaking space between number and unit.",
  "Currency: 29,99 € (non-breaking space).",
  "Dates: 29.11.2022; long 29. marraskuuta 2022. Time: klo 21.00."
].join(NL),
no: [
  "Norwegian (Bokmål) Style Guide – Global (DRAFT v2, read 02.11.26). Glossary takes precedence.",
  "Spelling: Det norske akademis ordbok (naob.no), Språkrådet. Abbreviations: f.eks., dvs., osv., nr., kl., t, min, s.",
  "Tone: informal, helpful, engaging yet professional; active voice; clear and readable, avoid long complex or noun-heavy formal sentences; no word-for-word translation, rephrase naturally.",
  "Register: always 'du'; never 'De'/'ni'.",
  "Inclusiveness: gender-neutral words where possible (talsperson).",
  "Buttons and CTAs: imperative (Start nå, Les mer). Help-center headlines: infinitive. Instructions in body text: imperative (Åpne Innstillinger).",
  "Syntax: avoid overusing possessive pronouns (Åpne kameraet på telefonen).",
  "Capitalization: sentence case; when citing UI elements capitalize the first letter, no quotation marks (Klikk på Lagre). TM: Personvernerklæring, Vilkår for bruk.",
  "Punctuation: exclamation marks and superlatives sparingly; quotation marks « »; en dash for ranges (1–5); full stop after complete sentences, none in headlines; write 'og' instead of '&'.",
  "Numbers: 9,99; thousands with space 10 000; percent '5 %' (non-breaking space); non-breaking space between number and unit.",
  "Currency: number + non-breaking space + ISO code (5 USD).",
  "Time/date: kl. 21.00 or klokken 21; 12. oktober 2025 or 12.10.2025."
].join(NL),
pl: [
  "Polish Style Guide – Global (DRAFT v2, read 02.11.26). Glossary takes precedence.",
  "Abbreviations: never # for numbers, use 'nr'; np., tj., itd., godz., min, s.",
  "Tone: friendly, clear and natural; avoid literal renderings of English structures; avoid the English passive (Użytkownik wykonał operację, not Operacja została wykonana przez użytkownika).",
  "Register: 2nd person singular in address and commands (Czas na podsumowanie twoich testów. Kliknij ten przycisk, aby wyświetlić wyniki.). Possessive 'twój/twoje' lowercase.",
  "Inclusiveness: gender-neutral forms; avoid gendered past-tense verbs addressed to the user (Popełniono trzy błędy, not Popełniłeś trzy błędy); prefer impersonal or present/future forms.",
  "Buttons and CTAs: imperative 2nd person singular (Pobierz, Zaloguj się, Zarejestruj się, Skontaktuj się z nami).",
  "Capitalization: never copy English capitalization in UI names (kliknij przycisk Pobierz plik).",
  "Punctuation: avoid exclamation marks carried over from English; Polish quotes „…”; en dash – instead of hyphen as a dash; write 'i' instead of '&'.",
  "Numbers: decimal comma 3,14; versions keep periods (macOS 10.15); numbers above 9999 grouped with non-breaking spaces (10 000 000); percent without space (99%); ordinals with period (1.); non-breaking space between number and unit (234 kg).",
  "Currency: 29,99 zł, 29,99 € (non-breaking space).",
  "Time/date: 24-hour format (convert AM/PM); DD/MM/YYYY or DD/MM/YY."
].join(NL)
};
const cfg = $('Config').first().json;
return cfg.langs.filter(function (iso) { return G[iso]; }).map(function (iso) { return { json: { iso: iso, data: G[iso] } }; });

const g = $('Gate').all().map(function (i) { return i.json; });
return [{ json: { results: $input.all().map(function (r, i) { const b = r.json.body || {}; return { iso: (g[i] || {}).iso, sent: (g[i] || {}).n, status: r.json.statusCode, written: (b.keys || []).length, errors: b.errors || b.error || null }; }) } }];
